checks: 4h budget bar closes strictly before the signal instant
entry time is strictly after the signal instant
entry and signal times are inside the development interval

cluster_primary_S7.note: Kish is a concentration diagnostic, not an estimate of serial dependence and not the definitive effective sample size of returns. The rho series is the frozen formula using the arithmetic mean non-empty cluster size; the exact Kish value uses the size-weighted mean and is reported separately.

population_labels.S0: session buckets whose signal instant is in the development interval
population_labels.S6: valid entry/stop, pre-gate; M_all population and required cluster view
population_labels.S7: cost-feasible; M_feasible population and K3 primary cluster population
population_labels.S9: canonical 24h non-overlapping; opportunity count and required cluster view

sensitivity_4h_exemption.note: Reruns the candidate with the twelve registered gap-adjacent 4h buckets marked unusable and the 4h ATR segment-broken at them. It is reported for transparency only and never changes the primary signal set, denominator, or verdict.

session_full_data.note: session_full_data is a post-count diagnostic over all 32 session bars. It never removes, defers, or relabels a signal.

us_only.note: Diagnostic variant restricted to US sessions; the all-session canonical count governs.

concentration.note: Pre-declared descriptive screening criterion, not a statistical test and not a dependence estimate.

verdict.frozen_tier_meaning: Tier label from the frozen candidate specification, reported separately. Neither tier nor PASS is evidence of profitability.
verdict.precedence: INCONCLUSIVE, then INSUFFICIENT OPPORTUNITIES, then EXCESSIVE CONCENTRATION, then FEASIBILITY PASS
